name: Clear Cell Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for CCPRCC

criteria.description: Presence of papillary and tubular architecture with clear cells and nuclei aligned away from the basement membrane
Diffuse positivity for cytokeratin 7 (CK7) and negative or focal positivity for CD10
Absence of VHL gene mutations and 3p deletions typical of clear cell RCC

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histological features consistent with CCPRCC plus characteristic immunohistochemical profile
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular testing helps differentiate CCPRCC from other RCC subtypes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Clear cell morphology with papillary architecture on histopathology
searchTerms: clear cells with finger-like tissue patterns
papillary structures with clear cell appearance
histology showing clear cells and papillae

common.symptomName: Flank pain localized to affected kidney
Mild anemia secondary to chronic disease
searchTerms: low red blood cells due to long-term disease

occasional.symptomName: Hypertension related to renal mass effect
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney mass
renal mass causing high blood pressure
unintentional weight loss and poor appetite

occasional.symptomName: Polycythemia due to ectopic erythropoietin production
searchTerms: high red blood cell count from abnormal hormone
excess red blood cells due to hormone production
increased red blood cells from ectopic erythropoietin

rare.symptomName: Metastatic symptoms such as bone pain or cough
searchTerms: symptoms from cancer spreading to bones or lungs

laboratory: Mild anemia or polycythemia on complete blood count
Normal to mildly elevated serum calcium
imaging: Well-circumscribed renal cortical mass on CT or MRI
No evidence of venous invasion typical of clear cell RCC
other: Immunohistochemistry positive for CK7 and negative or focal CD10
Low-grade nuclear features with nuclei oriented away from basement membrane

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of VHL mutations and 3p deletions

redFlags: Severe paraneoplastic syndromes such as hypercalcemia or erythrocytosis
references: Tickoo SK, et al. Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma: a distinct histologic and molecular genetic entity. Am J Surg Pathol. 2011.
Trpkov K, et al. Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma: a review of morphology and immunohistochemistry. Adv Anat Pathol. 2014.
Orphanet Report on Clear Cell Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma, ORPHA:404511.
